dedupe_keys.name: experimental data of a floating cylinder in a wave tank comparison solid and water ballast

description: The University of Edinburgh publishes wave-tank measurements comparing solid ballast with four internal water drafts in a floating cylinder. FloWave experiments record seven wave gauges and six-degree-of-freedom body motion under regular waves with a 0.05 m initial amplitude and frequencies from 0.3 to 1.1 Hz. DataShare supplies overview and individual-run TXT files available as a ZIP download freely under CC BY 4.0. These laboratory observations can validate fluid–structure interaction simulations for floating marine or offshore-energy systems, including internal sloshing effects. Large rotations approach twenty degrees, but the scaled cylinder and controlled forcing limit transfer to full-scale devices. No directly related catalogue benchmark was identified.
name: Experimental Data of a Floating Cylinder in a Wave Tank – Comparison Solid and Water Ballast
notes: G4-0350; G4 other data journals. Metadata only. Simulation uses are reviewer assessments. Data payloads and code execution were not checked.
